text: A mask changes every letter of the message by a fixed rule before the main cipher. Here the rules are the decimated alphabets: every step size through the alphabet, reading backwards included.
With the message read backwards from A, places 22 and 29 force J and K in the same slot: dead for a 7-letter word.

22 masks before a repeating key, ciphertext autokey or both: dead or at chance, and no word in 668 fragments. The 79 single-check survivors are above the controls but never reach a second check together.
